Given the current ROE of 9.2%, [E13], this underperformance could be an indication of undervaluation by investors. RVNL's strong historical performance in return on equity over multiple timeframes indicates that it has consistently outperformed its peers, which is a significant factor in favor of investing in RVNL. Furthermore, the P/E ratio of 58.7 [E1] and P/B ratio of 4.73 [E7], when compared to sector benchmarks, suggest that RVNL may be trading at a discount relative to its performance, further supporting the notion that it is being underappreciated by the market.
